# Vendored dependencies

- Supabase JavaScript SDK 2.117.2 UMD — https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js (MIT).
- QRCode.js / qrcodejs 1.0.0 — https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs (MIT).

Pinned copies are bundled to avoid a runtime dependency on a public CDN. Original licenses are adjacent.
The application does not send QR payloads to a third-party QR generation server.
Review SDK security updates before long-term production operation. Edge Function has no third-party runtime dependencies.
